mapper.sql: id, task_id, task_type, trigger_type, trigger_value, threshold_value, first_trigger_time, last_trigger_time, trigger_count, status, level, acknowledge_by, acknowledge_time, resolve_time, suppressed_until, message, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alarm_active WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND task_type = #{taskType} AND status != 'RESOLVED' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM alarm_active WHERE status != 'RESOLVED' ORDER BY last_trigger_time DESC
SELECT FROM alarm_active WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY last_trigger_time DESC
SELECT FROM alarm_active WHERE status = 'FIRING' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, first_trigger_time, NOW()) >= #{minutes} ORDER BY first_trigger_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alarm_active( task_id, task_type, trigger_type, trigger_value, threshold_value, first_trigger_time, last_trigger_time, trigger_count, status, level, message, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{taskType}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{firstTriggerTime}, #{lastTriggerTime}, #{triggerCount}, #{status}, #{level}, #{message}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm_active SET trigger_value = #{triggerValue}, threshold_value = #{thresholdValue}, last_trigger_time = #{lastTriggerTime}, trigger_count = #{triggerCount}, status = #{status}, level = #{level}, acknowledge_by = #{acknowledgeBy}, acknowledge_time = #{acknowledgeTime}, resolve_time = #{resolveTime}, suppressed_until = #{suppressedUntil}, message = #{message}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
